description: K₆Na₂V₂S₇O₃₀ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_32_12 space group. There are three inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-3.24 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-3.33 Å. In the third K site, K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.09 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.91 Å. V is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-2.34 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.46 Å) and two longer (1.52 Å) S-O bond lengths. In the second S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.56 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.57 Å. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.59 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one V, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one K, one V, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two K, one V, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one V, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two K and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two K, one Na, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three K and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two K, one Na, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two K, one Na, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three K and one S atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two K, one Na, and one S atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K and one V atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two K, one V, and one S atom.
